sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 660. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 80% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 100 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge gains by 3 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 90 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Envy Collapse (blocks max HP increase effects, increases Ability Power of damage taken by 30, increases cooldown by 30%, and increases Ability Cost consumption by 100%) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Increases Ability cooldown times by 50% for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
Fire and Light Defense from Unison Damage +500
